nodes.name: Recording & Trail
nodes.purpose: Maintains an immutable ledger of all activities, profiles, and interactions for safeguarding and proof-of-work.
nodes.ux_intent: Provide ultimate peace of mind through radical transparency; profiles should feel like unforgeable professional resumes.
nodes.vertical_notes: Critical for safeguarding in caregiving ('who was with this child?'); establishes trust in cleaning (DBS, property access).
nodes.case_integration: Direct pipeline to Case Portfolio app as the source of truth for worker proof.

nodes.name: Audit Trail
nodes.purpose: Timestamped log of every significant state transition or action taken within the platform.
nodes.ux_intent: Invisible to users but invaluable to admins during conflict resolution.
nodes.vertical_notes: Essential for resolving disputes regarding cleaning damages or caregiving timelines.

nodes.name: Write Audit Entry
nodes.purpose: Appends a new immutable record to the audit log for any system action.
nodes.ux_intent: Silent and secure background operation.
nodes.vertical_notes: Logs every time a booking is created, altered, or a profile is viewed.

nodes.name: View Audit Trail
nodes.purpose: Allows administrators to reconstruct the timeline of events for an entity (e.g., a specific booking).
nodes.ux_intent: A highly readable, chronological story of what happened and when.
nodes.vertical_notes: Used heavily when investigating a client complaint about a late cleaner or missing nanny.

nodes.name: Add Incident Note
nodes.purpose: Enables admins to manually append a contextual note or incident report to a booking's timeline.
nodes.ux_intent: Simple inline form to attach context without breaking the chronological flow.
nodes.vertical_notes: Crucial for logging safeguarding concerns in caregiving or property damage in cleaning.

nodes.name: Export Audit Trail
nodes.purpose: Generates a standardized PDF or CSV of an audit log for legal or compliance purposes.
nodes.ux_intent: One-click export ready for authoritative sharing.
nodes.vertical_notes: Used for external safeguarding investigations or insurance claims.

nodes.name: Worker Profile
nodes.purpose: Generates and maintains a comprehensive, verifiable profile for each worker.
nodes.ux_intent: Workers feel proud of their automatic portfolio; clients feel immediate trust.
nodes.vertical_notes: Nannies display age group expertise and pediatric First Aid; Cleaners display property types and deep clean skills.
nodes.case_integration: This is the primary data structure that maps to a Case App profile.

nodes.name: Rebuild Profile
nodes.purpose: Automatically aggregates latest assignments, ratings, and credential updates into the profile.
nodes.ux_intent: Zero effort for the worker—the profile gets stronger organically as they work.
nodes.vertical_notes: Auto-adds 'completed 5 end-of-tenancy cleans' or '100+ hours infant care'.
nodes.case_integration: Pushes updated proof items to Case Portfolio.

nodes.name: View Public Profile
nodes.purpose: Displays the public-facing version of the worker's verified profile to clients or visitors.
nodes.ux_intent: A beautiful, trustworthy digital resume that sells the worker's competence.
nodes.vertical_notes: Sanitizes private data (exact address, last name). Showcases verified DBS check status prominently.

nodes.name: View Own Profile
nodes.purpose: Allows the worker to see how their profile appears to others and review their stats.
nodes.ux_intent: Instills pride and gives the worker control over their professional presentation.
nodes.vertical_notes: Worker can see internal metrics like 'On-time percentage' that clients might not see.

nodes.name: Edit Worker Bio
nodes.purpose: Lets the worker update their personal statement, profile photo, and preferences.
nodes.ux_intent: Simple text editing with immediate preview. Feels personal and empowering.
open_questions: Do bio updates require admin moderation before going live?
nodes.vertical_notes: Nannies often write extensive bios detailing their caregiving philosophy.

nodes.name: Toggle Profile Visibility
nodes.purpose: Allows workers to hide their profile from public search if they are not accepting new clients.
nodes.ux_intent: One-tap control over their own discoverability, respecting their time.
nodes.vertical_notes: Important for nannies who have secured a full-time placement and want privacy.

nodes.name: Ratings & Reviews
nodes.purpose: Handles the dual-rating system post-assignment to maintain marketplace quality.
nodes.ux_intent: Quick, emoji-driven feedback that feels low-effort but provides high-signal data.
nodes.vertical_notes: Caregiving ratings focus on punctuality and child engagement; cleaning ratings focus on thoroughness.
nodes.case_integration: Ratings feed into the Case Portfolio as vouches.

nodes.name: Submit Client Rating
nodes.purpose: Captures the client's 1-5 star rating and optional textual review for a completed assignment.
nodes.ux_intent: Frictionless inline rating request sent via email/SMS; 'Rate in one tap'.
nodes.vertical_notes: Anonymous clients can rate via their secure token link after paying.
nodes.case_integration: High ratings convert to 'Vouches' in the Case App.

nodes.name: Submit Worker Rating
nodes.purpose: Captures the worker's internal rating of the client for worker wellbeing and safety tracking.
nodes.ux_intent: A private, safe space for workers to flag problematic environments or highly commend good ones.
nodes.vertical_notes: Crucial for flagging unsanitary cleaning environments or disrespectful caregiving clients.

nodes.name: Compute Average Ratings
nodes.purpose: Recalculates the aggregated score for a worker or client and checks against suspension thresholds.
nodes.ux_intent: System self-regulates quality quietly in the background.
nodes.vertical_notes: Workers dropping below 4.0 stars may trigger an automated admin review.

nodes.name: View Worker Ratings
nodes.purpose: Displays a paginated list of textual reviews on the worker's public profile.
nodes.ux_intent: Social proof that builds immediate trust through real human stories.
nodes.vertical_notes: Highlights 'Repeat Client' tags to show strong retention for that nanny/cleaner.

nodes.name: Moderate Rating
nodes.purpose: Allows an admin to hide or remove abusive, discriminatory, or highly contested reviews.
nodes.ux_intent: Protects workers from unfair retaliation; ensures a respectful platform.
nodes.vertical_notes: Used when clients leave retaliatory 1-star reviews because a cancellation fee was enforced.

nodes.name: Assignment History
nodes.purpose: Maintains the indisputable historical record of completed work for safeguarding and proof.
nodes.ux_intent: A crystalline, unalterable log that serves as the ultimate arbiter of truth.
nodes.vertical_notes: Tracks care type, hours, and location type (e.g., 'Residential 3-bed' or 'Infant Care').
nodes.case_integration: Provides the raw granular data that backs up the aggregated Case Portfolio profile.

nodes.name: Write History Entry
nodes.purpose: Commits a completed assignment to the immutable history ledger.
nodes.ux_intent: Solidifies the worker's accomplishment automatically at checkout.
nodes.vertical_notes: Strips out exact PII address data, storing only generalized location (e.g., 'London NW1') for portfolio sharing.

nodes.name: View Worker History
nodes.purpose: Allows the worker to see every job they have ever completed on the platform.
nodes.ux_intent: A satisfying, scrollable wall of achievement and reliable memory aid.
nodes.vertical_notes: Workers can use this to demonstrate experience levels outside the app.

nodes.name: View Client History
nodes.purpose: Allows a registered client to review all past services delivered to them.
nodes.ux_intent: Effortless retrieval of past invoices or re-booking favorite workers.
nodes.vertical_notes: Clients can easily pull up exactly when their last deep clean was performed.

nodes.name: Safeguarding View
nodes.purpose: Specialized admin view designed to reconstruct exactly who was present at a location/with a child during a specific time window.
nodes.ux_intent: Rapid, high-confidence data retrieval during stressful incidents or investigations.
nodes.vertical_notes: The most critical compliance feature for caregiving platforms.

nodes.name: Case Portfolio Export
nodes.purpose: Manages the automated flow of verifiable proof data into the worker's external Case App portfolio.
nodes.ux_intent: Platform seamlessly acts as an automatic credential-builder for the worker's broader career.
nodes.vertical_notes: Caregivers build an undeniable track record of hours and parental vouches; cleaners build reliability metrics.

nodes.name: Build Case Payload
nodes.purpose: Transforms platform profile and history data into the cryptographic/structured format required by Case App.
nodes.ux_intent: Invisible data structuring ensuring perfect compatibility.
nodes.vertical_notes: Translates '5-star rating from Parent' into a standardized Case 'Vouch'.
nodes.case_integration: Formats data strictly to Case Portfolio specifications.

nodes.name: Push to Case Portfolio
nodes.purpose: Transmits the built payload to the Case App API to update the worker's universal profile.
nodes.ux_intent: Worker receives a satisfying notification from Case App that their portfolio grew.
nodes.vertical_notes: Happens async to avoid blocking the core platform experience.

nodes.name: Worker Consent Toggle
nodes.purpose: Allows the worker to opt in or out of sharing their platform data with the Case App.
nodes.ux_intent: Clear, plain-English data rights. Worker is always in control of their information.
nodes.vertical_notes: Complies with GDPR and ensures nannies can maintain privacy if desired.
nodes.case_integration: The gatekeeper for all Case App data flows.
